releases.release_notes: Workspaces, window tiling, Rouge approval cards, and working Restart / Power Off.
releases.notes: Operator Console phase 2, part 2. Workspaces: Operations / Build / Personal — switch from the top bar, the rail dots, or Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3 (Ctrl+Alt+Left/Right cycles). Each workspace keeps its own windows; opening an app that lives elsewhere brings it here. Tiling: Ctrl+Alt+T or the tile button arranges this workspace's windows (1 full, 2 side by side, 3 = main + two stacked, more = grid). Approvals: when Rouge asks to run a command, an 'Approval needed' card appears in Rouge's chat with Approve once / Deny, a gold count on the Rouge rail button and a toast. Approve still runs only through the governed, allowlisted terminal. Backend adds POST /api/terminal/reject. Power: Restart and Power Off in the MEOS menu now really work (POST /api/system/restart|poweroff via logind; one-time polkit setup with meos-power-setup) and show a shutdown screen. Crash records: a machine that was switched off (UTM Stop) is now recorded as power-loss, not a Rouge crash; a refused start (port in use) no longer leaves a false crash behind.

releases.release_notes: New Settings app, Files and My Work fixes, readable ticker, backup market quotes, Wolverine WebRTC shield.
releases.notes: New Settings app laid out like macOS/Windows: General, Appearance (auto-hide bars, ticker, watchlist), Workspaces & Keyboard (the shortcut manual), Software Update, Privacy & Security (CADE key), Power, About. Keyboard hints removed from the empty desktop. Files: opening a folder inside a folder works (fixes HTTP 400 state/state). My Work opens again (backend now provides waiting_on_me, including Rouge's held commands). Ticker labels read like English (Club members 10, Pending reviews 0). Market quotes fall back to Yahoo Finance's public chart data when Stooq is unreachable. StarBrook: Wolverine WebRTC IP shield on by default (no STUN to Google/Cloudflare; pages can't read your public IP) with a switch in StarBrook Settings; restart StarBrook to apply.

releases.release_notes: Rouge thinks with your Azure model and uses MEOS tools, with your approval for changes.
releases.notes: Phase 4, part 1: Rouge's brain. Chat with Rouge now thinks with the owner's Azure model (Responses API, deployment cade-gpt56-sol by default) when connected in Settings > Privacy & Security > Rouge's brain. MEOS runs Rouge's tools locally: machine_status, list_files, read_file, list_tasks, business_stats, list_recipes answer immediately; run_command is HELD as an Approve once / Deny card and never runs on its own; write_file and start_recipe report that they arrive in a later update. The API key is stored in /etc/meos/secrets/brain.env (0600), never logged or shown. Without a key Rouge keeps its local answers. Also: My Work and Approvals counts no longer read 'undefined'; Software Update no longer shows a stale 'restart to apply' after an update is installed.

releases.release_notes: Approvals now show their result and Rouge reports back; Rouge's replies are formatted.
releases.notes: Rouge approvals report back. After Approve once (or Deny) on a card Rouge asked for, the card shows 'Approved — running…' and then the real terminal output, and Rouge is told the result and reports it in the chat. Cards decided somewhere else stop showing buttons. The Rouge chat now keeps its conversation if the window is redrawn. Rouge replies render lists, bold and code instead of raw asterisks. UI only; the backend is unchanged.

releases.release_notes: Assembly Floor: live view of agents, builds, and approvals. The factory floor for MEOS.
releases.notes: Assembly Floor: Matthew's private control room. Live agent runtime view (Running/Waiting/Done/Agents), unified approval queue (same source as chat cards, bidirectional sync), build/recipe history with logs, and agent lifecycle management. Built-in agents: Rouge (on-demand), Watchdog (health every 15m), Snapshot (pre-update), Log Sweep (daily). Scout→draft→approval→publish pipeline flows through existing governance. No fake liveness — empty states are honest.

The account only ever receives site names and counts. Ships the whole app folder (80 files) so every file is consistent. Restart StarBrook to load it.

releases.notes: Terminal fix. Keystrokes were taking ~8 s to reach the shell: the Terminal fired a new output request every 250 ms and each one waited up to 10 s, so the browser's 6-connection limit queued every keystroke behind them (and output answered to abandoned requests was lost). Now exactly one output request is open at a time (server waits 8 s, browser 15 s), keystrokes are sent in order one request at a time, and output goes through a small screen model so carriage return, backspace, erase-line and cursor moves edit the line instead of showing as boxes. Backend decodes UTF-8 across reads and starts bash with TERM=xterm-256color. Restarts meos-rouge (open terminal sessions end).
